instruction: Add Thunderbird to the favorite applications in the favorites bar.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding Thunderbird to the favorite applications. Initial state has vim.desktop and google-chrome.desktop. The evaluator checks that the final state includes all three applications (order doesn't matter due to set comparison in check_gnome_favorite_apps). Uses existing check_gnome_favorite_apps metric function.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts favorite apps list using appropriate gsettings command
Metric logic correctly verifies all requirements: set comparison ensures all three apps (vim, chrome, thunderbird) are present regardless of order
Expected value is semantically correct: includes all required apps (existing vim.desktop, google-chrome.desktop + new thunderbird.desktop)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks that Thunderbird is added while preserving existing favorites
No postconfig needed: gsettings reads persistent system state, no UI dependencies
Data flow is correct: gsettings output string -> parsed list -> set comparison -> binary result
Edge cases handled: length check prevents partial matches, set comparison handles order variations
